dict.4: NATIVE HAWAIIAN OR OTHER PACIFIC ISLANDER

method.description:
Executable yamaa derivation: case:
- when: STR_CONTAINS(RACE_RAW, ',')
  then: '''MULTIPLE'''
- otherwise:
    mapping:
      source: RACE_RAW
      dict:
        '1': AMERICAN INDIAN OR ALASKA NATIVE
        '2': ASIAN
        '3': BLACK OR AFRICAN AMERICAN
        '4': NATIVE HAWAIIAN OR OTHER PACIFIC ISLANDER
        '5': WHITE
        '6': OTHER
      missing: UNKNOWN
      unmapped: UNKNOWN
